C1499.title: Selfish Mining-Based Denial-of-Service Attack Against Bitcoin Systems (SDoS)
C1499.summary: This study introduces a selfish mining-based denial-of-service attack (SDoS) and further designs three more aggressive variants: competitive greedy SDoS, trajectory greedy SDoS, and hybrid greedy SDoS. Experiments show that an attacker with 14% of the total network hash power can increase profitability (compared to 25% for classic selfish mining and 19.6% for SDoS), while possessing 15% hash power
